prior_exposure: All original development and additional-sample headline results already inspected. This is not confirmatory or externally registered.

systems.Mean: Unconditional arithmetic mean of saved H and original four-label capped claims, all rows including fallback zeros
systems.CalH: clip(H + delta, 0,100), delta=mean(y_dev-H_dev), fitted exclusively to 900 development examples; no further fitting, selection, or threshold tuning

endpoints: Post-hoc SV minus Mean Spearman and MAE, plus comparisons with H and CalH; descriptive complete metric tables. Original two primary Spearman endpoints unchanged.

bootstrap.clusters: language, retain all 20 rows per sampled language
bootstrap.multiplicity_sensitivity: Bonferroni-style per-contrast 97.5% percentile intervals (1.25,98.75) for the two original primary Spearman contrasts only; approximate bootstrap sensitivity, not newly confirmed primary tests.

within_language: For each system report defined and undefined Spearman correlations, median and IQR among defined correlations and positive-count; no precise language rankings or language hypothesis tests. Undefined when either reference or system is constant.
semantic_review: No new independent human review exists; do not present AI review or retrospective codebook as independent validation.
